output.explanation: Implemented all ten b10 diagram edits using the revision-pinned sources. Alternatives and panels now replace the proposed branches, with content bindings, review application and display selection kept distinct. Saved views explain working copies, pinned forks and archival; managed generation explains isolated children, save acknowledgement and publication. All trees fit their reserved bounds, retained attachment labels remain exact, and the new generation tree has exactly 48 concept lines. Only the specified edge is returned. Saved endpoints and caller-context boundaries establish foundations for later comparison sessions and reusable saved contexts without portraying those later features as implemented.
